mechanism: Both drugs can cause electrolyte abnormalities and renal function impairment; hydroxychloroquine may accumulate with bisphosphonate-induced renal decline, and both carry risks of hypocalcemia and hypomagnesemia.
action: Monitor renal function, serum calcium, magnesium, and phosphate regularly; ensure adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusion and assess hydroxychloroquine dose appropriateness if renal function declines.
